quest.title: Accidental Encounter
quest.description: You meet Gorou and Yae Miko near Yae Publishing House. Gorou seems to be somewhat troubled...

talks.objective: Talk to Gorou about how to deal with the situation
Go to a quiet spot to finish writing the replies

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay, let's just ignore her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't I help you overcome this weakness?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can start with some theoretical study...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can act as a personality you find difficult to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, Yae Miko's not all bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's steer clear of Yae Publishing House for now, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go keep watch at Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll stay and keep you company.
